title: staticroutebfd fails to uninstall static route after all the nexthop becomes unavailable
author: baorliu
body:

     - SONiC Support Forums - https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/sonicproject

     ---------------------------------------------------
     BUG REPORT INFORMATION
     ---------------------------------------------------
     Use the commands below to provide key information from your environment:
     You do NOT have to include this information if this is a FEATURE REQUEST
-->

#### Description
After all the nexthop becomes unavailable (corresponding BFD sessions are in DOWN state), 
the static route uninstallation from frr failed, still can be seen with "show ip route static" cmd.

<!--
     Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. config a back-to-back system, enable bfd for a static route (similar config in the peer system)
```
    "INTERFACE": {
        "Ethernet0|10.10.10.2/16": {}
    },
    "STATIC_ROUTE": {
        "192.84.0.0/16": {
            "advertise": "false",
            "bfd": "true",
            "ifname": "Ethernet0",
            "nexthop": "10.10.10.1"
        }
    },
``` 
2. after the system is up and BFD sessions are UP for the static route, delete BFD session from the peer system, make the BFD session DOWN in local system

#### Describe the results you received:
```
cisco@sonic:~$ show ip route static
:
Codes: K - kernel route, C - connected, S - static, R - RIP,
       O - OSPF, I - IS-IS, B - BGP, E - EIGRP, N - NHRP,
       T - Table, v - VNC, V - VNC-Direct, A - Babel, F - PBR,
       f - OpenFabric,
       > - selected route, * - FIB route, q - queued, r - rejected, b - backup
       t - trapped, o - offload failure

S>* 192.84.0.0/16 [1/0] via 10.10.10.1, Ethernet0, weight 1, 00:00:27

``` 

#### Describe the results you expected:
should no output for "show ip route static"

#### Output of `show version`:

```
(paste your output here)
```
#### Output of `show techsupport`:

```
(paste your output here or download and attach the file here )
```

#### Additional information you deem important (e.g. issue happens only occasionally):
the deletion was working but one condition was missed when adding dynamic bfd enable/disable feature.
the skip deletion is to avoid race condition between StaticRouteMgr(config_db) and StaticRouteMgr(appl_db)
<!--
     Also attach debug file produced by `sudo generate_dump`
-->

linkedPullRequests.title: [staticroutebfd] fix static route uninstall issue if no nexthop
linkedPullRequests.author: baorliu
linkedPullRequests.body:
fixes #15574 
fix static route uninstall issue when all nexthops are not reachable. 
the feature was working but the bug was introduced when support dynamic bfd enable/disable. 

<!--
     Please make sure you've read and understood our contributing guidelines:
     https://github.com/Azure/SONiC/blob/gh-pages/CONTRIBUTING.md

     ** Make sure all your commits include a signature generated with `git commit -s` **

     If this is a bug fix, make sure your description includes "fixes #xxxx", or
     "closes #xxxx" or "resolves #xxxx"

     Please provide the following information:
-->

#### Why I did it
If a static route is bfd protected, when all the bfd sessions are down and all the nexthop need to be removed from the static route, it fails because a kip condition is missing.


##### Work item tracking
- Microsoft ADO **(number only)**:

#### How I did it
To support bfd config dynamic change and avoid race condition when delete static route, there is a skip checking for staticRouteMgr(appl_db) to check if the deletion should be skipped. Besides checking if the route exists in config_db, also need to check if the route is bfd protected.
